description: Parkeersectoren gemeente Heemstede is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by heemstede.nl. This dataset contains the locations of all parking sectors within the municipality of Heemstede. In addition to the location, each record includes an ID, sector and rate. The dataset is updated monthly, unless no changes have been made to the source data. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Parking sectors municipality of Heemstede" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Landgebruik, Parkeersectoren, Heemstede. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
